name: codinglombok/lomboksimhash
description: Locality-sensitive hashing for near-duplicate document detection. SimHash, MinHash, LSH, SHA-256, and shingling with identical results in PHP, TypeScript, Rust, Python and Go. Requires ext-gmp and ext-mbstring.

scripts.phpstan: cd ports/php && composer install --quiet --no-interaction && vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --no-progress
